title: Surat–Bilimora section: OHE energisation milestone
summary: NHSRCL and media reports place overhead equipment energisation on the roughly 50 km Surat–Bilimora stretch around 20 November 2026 — a commissioning step, not a passenger launch.

title: Gujarat package: OHE installation crosses 90% on priority sections
summary: NHSRCL Gujarat progress updates cite overhead line and traction substation work ahead of targeted energisation on the Surat–Bilimora corridor segment.

title: Made-in-India bullet train set (Train 18 HSR variant) on test track
summary: NHSRCL has highlighted the domestic high-speed trainset programme for early Gujarat operations, separate from later Japanese E10 deliveries.

title: Bharuch: major viaduct spans completed over Narmada approach
summary: Civil works photography and NHSRCL site bulletins show continued viaduct and approach embankment progress near Bharuch on the MAHSR alignment.

title: Vadodara HSR station: superstructure and platform works
summary: Station civil packages in Vadodara advance with platform and concourse structures; opening remains tied to corridor commissioning, not standalone.

title: PIB: Ministry briefing on MAHSR physical progress
summary: Government press information notes overall physical progress and reiterates phased opening targets — always check the original release for exact percentages and dates.

title: Sabarmati depot and northern terminal works
summary: Northern terminus depot and stabling lines at Sabarmati remain in active construction as part of the 508 km corridor programme.

title: Signalling & telecom package: tender pipeline signal
summary: Procurement notices on the NHSRCL portal continue to list signalling, telecom, and control-centre packages — useful markers for systems commissioning timelines.

title: Maharashtra: Thane Creek tunnel and BKC underground works
summary: NHSRCL updates on the Mumbai–Thane underground and Thane Creek tunnel segments — among the last civil challenges before Maharashtra track commissioning.

title: Surat depot: yard track and maintenance facilities
summary: Surat rolling-stock depot and associated yard work support the planned first commercial runs in Gujarat; passenger dates remain subject to official announcement.

title: Vapi station package: civil and entry works
summary: Vapi stop civil construction continues on the coastal Gujarat chain between Bilimora and Surat.

title: Anand / Nadiad: alignment and station footprint
summary: Central Gujarat stations on the MAHSR route show ongoing land development and station box works in NHSRCL periodic progress reports.
